Definition: ; a reduplicated and prolonged form of a primary πρέω; which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to fire, i.e. burn (figuratively and passively, become inflamed with fever):--be (X should have) swollen.
BiblicalUsage: Pimpremi means to swell, to burn with fever. It stands once, in Acts 28:6, when the islanders watched Paul after the viper bit him, expecting him to swell up or fall down dead — and when no harm came, they changed their minds and called him a god.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God can let the serpent bite and still keep His servant standing.
